name: slip_uart_tx
description: SLIP-framed UART transmitter, 8N1 at 20 clocks per bit: the lane escapes END/ESC per byte and SHIFTs each byte; the core's coded shifter frames it (start bit, 8 data bits LSB first, stop bit, idle high) and timer0, started by the same SHIFT, ticks every bit; the shifter's stop stops the timer, so each frame starts on a fresh bit period. The line is out0 (uio6), push-pull.
